about: Bitly reference samples transcribed with their complete published requests. Setup creates only the account and the example link.

steps.name: Publisher opens an account and registers the Dub callback

exampleDiffers.deeplinks: The reference renders one illustrative deeplink object. This published request creates no deeplink; the served schema imposes no minItems and its empty array is valid. Deeplink creation is an explicit variant gap outside Dub demand.

undecided.archived: The create request does not set archived; the reference gives only an unsupplied boolean representation.

notReplayed.getBitlinksByGroup#doc Retrieve Bitlinks: The reference sends campaign_guid, channel_guid and launchpad_ids together, plus unsupported QR/expiration filters. Those explicit variants are gaps outside Dub import demand. No supported API can create their prerequisites; retain the complete example rather than removing its parameters.
notReplayed.getGroupTags#doc Retrieve Tags by Group: The rendered curl sends type= with an empty string, whereas the published enum only admits bitlink or qr_code. This exact published request is not a valid request under its own schema; the life exercises the documented omitted-parameter default.
notReplayed.updateBitlink#doc Update a Bitlink: The complete default request supplies an Android deeplink with app_guid, app_uri_path, install_url and promote_install. Deeplinks are a declared variant gap outside the import/archive demand; no modeled mobile-app/deeplink flow can meet those prerequisites.
notReplayed.createFullBitlink#doc Customized Keyword: The complete published request asks for keyword customization, an explicit variant gap outside Dub import demand.
notReplayed.createFullBitlink#doc Add Keyword to Exi: The complete published request asks for keyword customization, an explicit variant gap outside Dub import demand.
notReplayed.createFullBitlink#doc With Expiration: The complete published request sets expiration_at, an explicit variant gap outside Dub import demand. Its retained July 2025 sample date also precedes this January 2026 World; it is not rewritten.
notReplayed.updateBitlink#doc Redirect Bitlink Desti: The complete published request changes the destination URL, an explicit variant gap outside Dub archive updates.
notReplayed.updateBitlink#doc With Expiration: The complete published request sets expiration_at, an explicit variant gap outside Dub import demand. Its retained July 2025 sample date also precedes this January 2026 World; it is not rewritten.
notReplayed.exchangeAccessToken#doc Resource owner c: This complete published request uses a username/password token grant, outside Dub web-flow demand. The pack has no Basic/password credential grant and cannot supply its prerequisites; only authorization-code exchange is modeled.
